text:
Type: white metal bell pendant lamp
Use: direct light over a dining table, a kitchen counter or a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: white lacquered metal shade, brushed aluminium yoke, transparent cord, grey metal ceiling cup
Colors: white, silver grey
Shape: rounded dome shade held in a half-circle yoke so it tilts, hangs on a slim cord, simple and compact, light visual weight
Feel: clean, crisp, light, functional
Goes with: white or light wood tables, grey and silver accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern kitchens

product.name: SVIRVEL
product.description: This lamp gives a pleasant light for dining and spreads a good directed light across your dining or bar table.
